header.description:
Do you want an experience where you're not greeted by the same grey interface every time you open a container? If so, Colourful OreUI is for you.

This pack changes practically every GUI and UI element in minecraft, featuring; fluid animations, polished, premium gradient finish, fresh boss bars and fresh shader panorama's for each version. Oh, and a whole load more that brings colour and life to Minecraft's UI.

Unofficial Bedrock port by §uQuartzEnder§r of §bMrGamingLoons'§r Colourful Oreui.

This pack features elements inspired by other resource packs:

 - AR's OreUI by amongsreality
- Re-colourful Containers by Vi_Tu
- Colourful Containers GUI by Kingybu
- Ore UI-ify by BoardSodie
- Unique Dark by amongstreality
- Ingot UI by Zeit709
- Colorful Containers OreUI (Never Released) by Springfall
- OreUI by Mojang Studios
header.name: Immersive Interfaces 1.0
